### Chesterfield vs Colchester United (Tuesday, 7:45 pm)

Chesterfield never got going and created just 0.26 in expected goals in their drab 1-0 loss at Port Vale on Saturday, though that was the first time in 12 matches in all competitions that the Spireites failed to score. Back at the SMH Group Stadium on Tuesday evening, where they’ve won four on the bounce in league and cup, Chesterfield could rebound, however. [...] Colchester were held at home by Exeter (0-0) at the weekend and are now seven games without a win in League Two. The U’s, who failed to score in each of their last two tests in the division, have yet to force a win on the road this term, and they’ve been conceding an average of 2.0 goals per away game since August.

Score prediction: Chesterfield 2-1 Colchester United

Back Chesterfield to Win against Colchester United at 8/13 with LiveScore Bet [...] ### Exeter City vs Crewe Alexandra (Tuesday, 7:45 pm)

Exeter kept a third successive clean sheet on Saturday when they earned a share of the spoils at Colchester and the Grecians’ three-game unbeaten surge has pushed them to within striking distance of the playoff positions. That was the eighth league fixture in a row involving City where under 2.5 goals landed, however.
